I composed the first discourse about everything that Jesus began to do and to teach,
usque in diem qua præcipiens Apostolis per Spiritum Sanctum,

even until the day on which he was taken up.
quibus et præbuit seipsum vivum post passionem suam in multis argumentis,
He also presented himself alive to them,
appearing to them throughout forty days and speaking about the kingdom of God with many elucidations.
præcepit eis ab Jerosolymis ne discederent,
he instructed them that they should not depart from Jerusalem,
but that they should wait for the Promise of the Father,
“about which you have heard,” he said, “from my own mouth.
For John, indeed, baptized with water,
vos autem baptizabimini Spiritu Sancto non post multos hos dies.
but you shall be baptized with the Holy Spirit, not many days from now.”
those who had assembled together questioned him,
si in tempore hoc restitues regnum Israël?
is this the time when you will restore the kingdom of Israel?”
“It is not yours to know the times or the moments,
vel momenta quæ Pater posuit in sua potestate:
which the Father has set by his own authority.
sed accipietis virtutem supervenientis Spiritus Sancti in vos,
But you shall receive the power of the Holy Spirit,
et eritis mihi testes in Jerusalem,
and you shall be witnesses for me in Jerusalem,
and in all Judea and Samaria,
and even to the ends of the earth.”
And when he had said these things,
et nubes suscepit eum ab oculis eorum.
and a cloud took him from their sight.
Cumque intuerentur in cælum euntem illum,
And while they were watching him going up to heaven,
ecce duo viri astiterunt juxta illos in vestibus albis,
behold, two men stood near them in white vestments.
why do you stand here looking up toward heaven?
qui assumptus est a vobis in cælum,

sic veniet quemadmodum vidistis eum euntem in cælum.

Tunc reversi sunt Jerosolymam a monte qui vocatur Oliveti,
Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain, which is called Olivet,
And when they had entered into the cenacle,
they ascended to the place where Peter and John,
James of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot,
Hi omnes erant perseverantes unanimiter in oratione cum mulieribus,
All these were persevering with one accord in prayer with the women, and with Mary,
rising up in the midst of the brothers,
said (now the crowd of men altogether was about one hundred and twenty):
oportet impleri Scripturam quam prædixit Spiritus Sanctus per os David de Juda,
the Scripture must be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit predicted by the mouth of David about Judas,
qui fuit dux eorum qui comprehenderunt Jesum:
who was the leader of those who apprehended Jesus.
He had been numbered among us,
et sortitus est sortem ministerii hujus.
and he was chosen by lot for this ministry.
Et hic quidem possedit agrum de mercede iniquitatis,
And this man certainly possessed an estate from the wages of iniquity, and so,
et suspensus crepuit medius: et diffusa sunt omnia viscera ejus.
